say: Why does some music sound happy,
The answer is just one note.
show: Why does some music sound happy, and some sad? The answer is *one note*.

say: This is a C major chord.
show: This is a *C major* chord: three notes, played together.

say: Now, move only the middle note,
show: Move only the middle note one key down: *E becomes E♭*.
Same bottom note, same top note. Now it sounds sad: a *minor* chord.

say: In a major chord, the middle note is four keys above the bottom one.
In a minor chord, just three.
show: Major: the middle note is *four keys* up. Minor: *three*.
It works from any note: *A major*, *A minor*.

say: On guitar, it is the same idea.
show: On guitar: E major. Lift *one finger*: E minor.

say: Now you will hear major and minor in every song you know.
show: Now you will hear major and minor in *every song you know*.
